hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook that lets anyone deploy memecoins trading on a concentrated liquidity curve denominated in an issuer-controlled quote token (e.g., USDG). Enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap, a 1% base fee plus optional decaying anti-snipe premium, and graduates pools to standard Uniswap v4 with a 1% LP fee once the raise target is reached.
